commands: uv sync                                  # install / update the environment
uv run pytest tests/test_x.py::test_y    # one test
uv run ruff check . --fix && uv run ruff format .
node scripts/gate.mjs                    # the full gate (same as CI)
map: src/{{SLUG_PY}}/      the package: all real logic lives here
notebooks/          exploration only; import from src/, outputs stripped
stackRules: - Python 3.11+, managed with uv. Add dependencies with `uv add <pkg>`; never pip install into the system.
- Type hints on every public function; dataclasses or Pydantic models for structured data.
- `pathlib.Path` for paths; never hard-code absolute paths.
- Logic lives in `src/`; notebooks import it. A notebook is never the only copy of anything.
- Random seeds are fixed and logged for anything stochastic.
- ruff for lint and format (the PostToolUse hook formats on save).
